title: observability: token/KV cache metrics, trace linking, dashboards and alert tuning
author: Marta Kovalenko
description: Context: Customers and SREs requested clearer token-level cost/latency attribution and visibility into KV cache behavior for multi-tenant deployments. This PR adds new token-level KV cache metrics, links token spans to distributed traces, updates Grafana dashboards with focused panels, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noise while preserving signal. Motivation: previously we surface token-level cost and latency but did not expose per-request KV cache hit/miss breakdown or a reliable trace link back to request spans, which made root-cause difficult for cache-related regressions. Changes: 1) Runtime telemetry: emit new metrics runtime.token.kv.cache_hits_total and runtime.token.kv.cache_misses_total with dimensions [model_version, deployment, route, tenancy] and ensure counts are emitted atomically with token emission. 2) Tracing: add span linking from token emitter to request span using trace_id/parent_id propagation; sample rate for traces set to 0.1% by default but token-related spans are tagged to allow targeted sampling in SRE projects. 3) Dashboard: add KV cache panels (hit rate, miss rate, per-model latency delta), token-level cost breakdown panels, and drilldown links from token panels to trace views. 4) Alert tuning: update token-cost spike and kv-miss-rate alerts to use a 5m->30m window aggregation and higher thresholds to reduce churn; add an SLO-backed alert for sustained >5% kv miss rate over 30m. 5) Backwards compatibility: metrics names are additive; no deletion of existing metrics. A small schema version bump (telemetry.v=2) is recorded so older analytics jobs can ignore new dimensions if needed. 6) Observability infra: migration script to backfill aggregated KV metrics for last 7 days in BigQuery and a small CLI helper to re-tag historical traces. Testing and validation: unit tests for metric emission and dimension labels, integration test exercising end-to-end trace linking on local canary, manual dashboard QA, and load smoke tests to verify negligible latency impact (observed <0.5% p95 increase in a 100rps synthetic run). Rollout plan: staged rollout to Dedicated->Hosted canaries->all regions with feature-flag gated trace linking. Playbook: SRE runbook updated with diagnostic steps to distinguish kv miss-induced latency. Release notes: "Adds token-level KV cache metrics, trace linking for token spans, dashboard panels for KV hit/miss/cost, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy alerts while preserving signal." Breaking change: false. Additional notes: privacy review completed; tenancy dimension is hashed to avoid PII. See ENG-5592 for followups to add per-customer quotas in dashboards.
